ItemID: NA; Title: The Essential Van Morrison; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A hits collection fits my recent listening, and his folk-rock sound appeals to me.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of Cat Stevens; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: His acoustic songwriting fits my interest in Simon & Garfunkel, Jonathan Edwards, and Melanie; I would choose this today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Johnny Cash Live at San Quentin; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in melodic pop and folk collections than a live country album right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Notte Magica - A Tribute to The Three Tenors; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for operatic singing in this listening session.
ItemID: NA; Title: Dances With Wolves Soundtrack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I want songs and vocals today rather than a film score.
ItemID: NA; Title: Gold; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not tell me the artist or songs, so I cannot identify a personal connection.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Best of INXS; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A rock hits collection could suit my interest in The Cars, but I would choose the folk and Beatles collections first today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Chronicle: 20 Greatest 1976; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I recognize this as a Creedence hits collection, which fits my recent classic-rock compilation listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Beatles 1967 1970; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My interest in Sgt. Pepper's makes this Beatles collection a strong choice for familiar songs and more from that period.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Time Jumpers; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have enough familiarity with this act to choose it over collections tied to artists I already enjoy.
